text_en: The spirit of the Lord God is upon me, because the Lord has anointed me; he has sent me to bring good news to the oppressed, to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and release to the prisoners;
text_cn: 吾主上主的神临到我身上，因为上主给我傅了油，派遣我向贫苦的人传报喜讯，治疗破碎了的心灵，向俘虏宣告自由，释放狱中的囚徒，

text_en: to proclaim the year of the Lord ’s favor, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all who mourn;
text_cn: 宣布上主恩慈的喜年，揭示我们天主报仇的日期，安慰一切忧苦的人，

text_en: to provide for those who mourn in Zion— to give them a garland instead of ashes, the oil of gladness instead of mourning, the mantle of praise instead of a faint spirit. They will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the Lord , to display his glory.
text_cn: 给熙雍悲哀的人一项冠冕来代替灰尘，喜乐的油以代替丧服，颂赞以代替沮丧的心神。他们将被称为正义的橡树，上主为光荣自己所种植的园地。

text_en: They shall build up the ancient ruins, they shall raise up the former devastations; they shall repair the ruined cities, the devastations of many generations.
text_cn: 他们要重建古时的废址，兴建往日的荒域，建造倾圮（pǐ）的城邑，数代荒凉的地方。

text_en: Strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, foreigners shall till your land and dress your vines;
text_cn: 外邦人要来为你们牧放羊群，外方人的儿子要作你们的农夫和葡萄园丁。

text_en: but you shall be called priests of the Lord , you shall be named ministers of our God; you shall enjoy the wealth of the nations, and in their riches you shall glory.
text_cn: 你们要被称为“上主的司祭，”人要称你们为“我们天主的侍役”；你们要享用万民的财物，以他们的财宝而夸耀。

text_en: Because their shame was double, and dishonor was proclaimed as their lot, therefore they shall possess a double portion; everlasting joy shall be theirs.
text_cn: 因为他们受了双重的耻辱，侮辱与唾骂是他们的家业，因此他们要承受双倍的土地；永远的喜乐将归属于他们。

text_en: For I the Lord love justice, I hate robbery and wrongdoing; I will faithfully give them their recompense, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
text_cn: 因为我是爱慕公义的上主，我恼恨不义的抢劫；我要凭忠实赐给他们报酬，与他们订立一项永久的盟约。

text_en: Their descendants shall be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples; all who see them shall acknowledge that they are a people whom the Lord has blessed.
text_cn: 他们的后裔在列国中，他们的苗裔在万民中，要受人赏识；凡看见他们的，必要承认他们是上主所祝福的后裔。

text_en: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord , my whole being shall exult in my God; for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation, he has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
text_cn: 我要万分喜乐于上主，我的心灵要欢跃于我的天主，因为他给我穿上救恩的衣服，给我披上义德的外衣，使我有如头戴花冠的新郎，有如佩带珍珠的新娘。

text_en: For as the earth brings forth its shoots, and as a garden causes what is sown in it to spring up, so the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
text_cn: 正如大地怎样产生苗芽，田园怎样使种子发芽，吾主上主也要怎样在万民前产生正义和赞扬。
